response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as overall_avg FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg as difference_from_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
